mainEntity.name: Can I get a free sample before ordering?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sample availability, charges, artwork work, dispatch and freight are confirmed for the chosen request. This page does not promise a free kit, a fixed dispatch time or an automatic credit against an order.

mainEntity.name: What should I include in a custom drinkware enquiry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a model or reference, intended use, estimated quantity, artwork, packing, destination and required arrival date. If a specification is undecided, describe the use so it can be reviewed with the model.

mainEntity.name: Are the reference images and specifications the final order?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the references to discuss the project. Confirm the final material, dimensions, components, artwork and sample in the written specification before production.

mainEntity.name: How is a quote request sent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Submit the project details and artwork on the contact page. The receiving service confirms storage with an enquiry reference. Email forwarding is pending configuration in this preview; website receipt does not mean an email has been delivered.

itemListElement.name: 定制杯样品与 Logo 审核

mainEntity.name: 下单前可以获得免费样品吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 样品供应、费用、图稿工作、发样时间和运费按具体申请确认。本页不承诺免费套装、固定发样时间或自动抵扣订单费用。

mainEntity.name: 定制询价需要提供哪些资料？

acceptedAnswer.text: 提供型号或参考、用途、预计数量、图稿、包装、交货地和到货日期。参数未确定时，可先描述用途，再按型号核对。

mainEntity.name: 参考图片和参数就是最终订单吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 参考资料用于沟通项目。生产前应在书面规格中确认材质、尺寸、组成、图稿和样品。
在联系页填写项目需求并上传图稿，接收服务确认保存后会显示询盘编号。当前预览的邮件转送尚未配置；网站接收成功不代表邮件已送达。

BUYER QUESTIONS

Clear answers before the next step.

Can I enquire before choosing a model?

Yes. Describe the intended use, quantity and arrival date; add a reference or drawing if available.

What determines MOQ and lead time?

The model, materials, design versions, decoration, packaging and tooling affect the proposal. Small batches from 10 pieces and fast sampling apply to eligible projects; confirm the conditions in your quote.

What should my enquiry include?

A model or product idea, quantity, artwork, pack contents, destination and required arrival date are a useful start.

采购常见问题

下一步之前，先说明白。

还没选定型号，可以询价吗？

可以。说明用途、数量和到货日期，有参考图或图纸可一并提供。

起订量与交期由什么决定？

型号、材料、图稿版本、装饰、包装与模具都会影响方案。10 件起及快速打样适用于相应项目，条件需在报价中确认。

询价需要提供什么？

型号或产品想法、数量、图稿、包装组成、目的地及期望到货日期，是有效的起点。

下一步

一起把项目需求明确下来。

提供型号或想法、数量、图稿、目的地及到货日期，可在询价中添加文件。
